text:
sara: Heads-up — planning to publish astral-6b-v2 to catalog tomorrow 09:30 PST. Want to coordinate canary + pin strategy.
linh: I can own the deploy window. timeline works for me.
kevin: Confirming model artifacts are in registry? hash and quantized artifacts ready?
sara: yes — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-models/astral/6b/v2/ (sha256: e3b0c4...). quant-8bit done.
nora: QA: I have a small prompt set (100 prompts) for smoke. When do you want those run?
sara: run them during canary (10% traffic) right after pin applied. expecting ~15min run.
ben: ops checklist: does infra need a proto-routing entry for v2? or will traffic go to a variant tag?
linh: we'll use catalog pinning with a variant label `astral-6b:stable->astral-6b-v2` only after canary passes. routing will create a transient variant `astral-6b-canary`.
kevin: canary config draft: {
  "percent": 10,
  "duration_min": 20,
  "routes": ["chat/generate","chat/stream"]
}
sara: looks good. also enable kv-prefix-cache warmup for the canary nodes.
deploy-bot: deploy job queued: deploy-catalog/astral-6b-v2 by @linh scheduled at 09:30 PST. Job id: cj-4829
linh: I’ll kick the job and watch the smoke. @ops-oncall can you monitor infra metrics?
ops-oncall: on it. watching p50/p95 latency, gpus util, and infra errors. will alert if token latency >80% of baseline.
kevin: quick smoke commands for QA:
```
# sample generate test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"astral-6b-canary","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain HTTP status codes"}],"max_tokens":64}' | jq .
```
linh: also run embedding hash sanity for cached routes: `python tools/emb_check.py --model astral-6b-canary --sample 50`
sara: rollback plan: if canary p95 > baseline*1.4 or error rate increases >1% absolute -> abort pin and roll back variant to `astral-6b-v1`.
nora: tests to run: latency, hallucination spot-check (10 prompts), safety filter hits, and top-k token distribution comparison. I'll post the result doc in #eng-ml after run.
ben: infra readiness: nodes in eu-west and us-west have spare capacity. autoscale set to min 2 per shard for canary. bursting disabled for canary (to ensure consistency).
linh: I'm going to deploy now. will post updates.
sara: thanks. quick ask — after canary passes, do we want immediate pin or staged pin over 2 hours?
kevin: recommend staged pin: +50% after 30m, +100% after 90m if no regressions. safer for production traffic.
linh: noted. I'll run 10% -> 50% -> 100% staged rollout with manual gates.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: deploy-catalog/astral-6b-v2 job cj-4829; canary variant created: astral-6b-canary.
ops-oncall: seeing initial warmup, p50 stable. p95 slightly higher by ~8% but within threshold. continuing to monitor.
sara: @nora when you have the smoke results ping here w/ short pass/fail.
nora: smoke done. results: latency OK, safety hits unchanged, hallucination spot-check has 2 minor regressions (examples attached). attaching doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/qa/astral6b-v2-smoke (will add gist).
kevin: can you paste one example failure thread here?
nora: found one prompt where answer truncated and one with minor factual drift. both appear tied to temperature change in v2 defaults.
sara: ok — two options: 1) tweak default sampling (temp 0.0 -> 0.2) and re-run quick smoke, or 2) proceed with staged pin but add regen-safeguard route that pins temp per-client. preference?
linh: prefer tweak defaults and re-run quick 10-min smoke. less risk.
ben: infra note: re-deploy with new config won't require new nodes. just push variant config.
linh: pushed variant config with temp=0.2. re-running smoke now.
ops-oncall: p95 back within 2% of baseline. no errors.
nora: smoke re-run — pass. hallucination regressions gone on the recheck subset.
sara: awesome. proceeding with staged pin. @linh please start +50% in 30m.
linh: scheduled staged increase at 10:15 PST. will post updates when each gate completes.
kevin: note for catalog: update model card with v2 changelog and sampling recommendation. also add rollback tag `astral-6b-v1-rollback-ready` to the previous artifact.
sara: added changelog draft to PR #4221.
linh: 50% gate complete: metrics look stable. moving to 100% in 60m unless objections.
kevin: no objections from my side.
ben: tracking infra costs — noted temporary bump for canary, will reconcile.
sara: 100% pin applied. closing loop: model pinned to astral-6b-v2, old v1 archived with rollback tag. thanks everyone. :tada: 
linh: leaving canary variant active for 24h for quick rollback if needed.
ora: I'll run a full eval overnight and report anomalies tomorrow morning.
ops-oncall: monitoring alerting on. will escalate if anything odd.
ben: closing note — added a short postmortem template for the rollout in the ops doc folder in case we need it.
sara: great work team. small follow-ups in PRs.
kevin: thanks all :thumbsup:
